newsitem.title: USA: US House Banking chair hopeful on financial reform.
newsitem.headline: US House Banking chair hopeful on financial reform.

text.p: House Banking Committee Chairman James Leach said Tuesday that he was hopeful on the prospects of financial modernization legislation this year.
"I'm hopeful that something substantive can come about," he told an America's Community Bankers conference.

He said that Congress should move "dramatically" to intertwine all areas of finance, such as banking, securities and insurance. However, he expressed reservation, as he has done in the past, about mixing commerce and banking.
"I am a great, great doubter of mixing of commerce and banking," the Iowa Republican said.
